policy.rule: Scheduled refreshes may redesign layout, typography, photo composition, decorative treatment, motion and responsive behavior. They must not alter credential facts or replace approved media without explicit owner input. Every new visual must be shown as a demo first and only appended here after explicit approval. Once 30 approved designs exist, reuse them in oldest-first order with at least a 30-day gap.
